eval_set.name: imagenet-val-50000
eval_set.source: ImageNet ILSVRC2012 validation set, all 50,000 images (1,000 classes x 50), original JPEGs (byte-identical to the ImageNet-100 val files of .cache/data/eval5000 where they overlap); images not redistributed
